_comment: DRISHTI Part K — REDUCED demo acceptance (Prompt 14). This is the single authoritative list of what the demo must prove; it is deliberately small. NoSQL, Cache, Mail, Push, SmartBrowz, QuickML and Circuits are NOT in the minimum set — they are tested only when that feature is actually enabled (see test_only_when_enabled). Each required check maps to how it is proven + its current status. acceptance_check.py reads this file and runs the checks that are runnable, reporting PASS/HELD/MANUAL/FAIL. Status legend: verified_offline = provable now without a deploy; held_on_deploy = needs the live Catalyst deployment; held_on_gpu = needs the AWS SageMaker GPU plane; ops_action = a cleanup action performed after testing.

required.how: GET the Slate / Web Client Hosting URL -> 200 and it serves the SPA shell.
An unsigned protected call is rejected (401) and a correctly signed/authenticated call succeeds (200). API Gateway -> Function -> signed context -> AppSail.
An authenticated API read returns rows sourced from Catalyst Data Store.
Upload ONE evidence file -> object in a private Stratus bucket + hash/size/type metadata in Data Store -> retrievable via a short-lived signed URL.

required.proves: An approved FIR reaches TabFM on AWS GPU.
required.how: Submit an approved-FIR prediction job -> poll -> a completed result with actual_backend=tabfm and actual_device=cuda (fail-closed otherwise).

required.proves: Prediction returns to Catalyst and appears in the UI.
required.how: The validated PredictionResult is persisted in Data Store and is visible via an API read / the UI (data-minimized notice via Gateway polling or the scoped SSE channel).
required.evidence: app/predict/{runtime,lineage}.py (result -> Data Store, AWS not authoritative); app/stream/.

required.proves: Drafts and evidence files do not invoke the model.
required.how: Routing for a FIR draft and an evidence upload returns invokes_model=false; the runtime refuses to submit.

required.proves: One Signal and one scheduled job work.
required.how: The minimal event plane declares exactly ONE active Signal (prediction-requested) and ONE active cron (drishti-forecast-daily); when enabled, an approved PredictionRequest fires prediction_event and the daily cron dispatches a forecast.

required.proves: No secrets exist in the browser.
required.how: No DATABASE_URL / RDS host / :5432 / AWS key / PEM / server-only key in the web env or bundle.
After testing, the SageMaker async endpoint is deleted so there is no standing GPU cost.

test_only_when_enabled.note: saved layouts/prefs/presence only; not a duplicate of relational records.
RAG/no-code baseline tested only when demonstrated (G.2).

test_only_when_enabled.when: if it becomes available in the IN DC
test_only_when_enabled.note: unavailable in IN DC; idempotent Functions + Jobs are used instead.
